title: Six Figs in a Tin
lines: Sal has six figs in a tin.
He hid the tin in a big bin.
A pig tips the bin and sits in it.
The figs are in the mud!
"Do not sit on the figs," said Sal.
The pig digs and digs in the mud.
It digs up a big fig!
Sal is not mad at the pig.
He fed the pig a fig and a bun.

questions.ask: Where did Sal hide the tin of figs?
questions.listenFor: In a big bin. It is said right in the story. If they guess, have them find the word bin and read that line again.

questions.ask: How did the figs end up in the mud?
questions.listenFor: The pig got in the bin and tipped it over. That is two steps, so it is fine for them to look back and find both parts.

questions.ask: Why do you think Sal is not mad at the pig? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. You want a reason from the story - the pig dug a fig back up, or Sal likes the pig anyway. The reason is the part you are listening for.
